texts.li: All morning {A_nameDef} followed {X_definite} about, trying names on it one after another until one seemed to fit.
{A_nameDef} has decided that {X_definite} is a friend, and friends need names. The grown-ups have been told the new one twice.
It took {A_nameDef} a long while, sitting on a crate and watching {X_definite} work, to settle on a name for it.
{A_nameDef} worked the next row over from {X_definite} for an hour, talking the whole time about frost, beetles and which beds want water. It said nothing back and did its row well.
Watching {X_definite} take the weeds out of a bed one by one, {A_nameDef} picked up a trick or two about spacing that {A_pronoun} hadn't thought of.
{A_nameDef} worked alongside {X_definite} in the fields for a while and found {A_pronoun} was trying to keep up with it.
[rain] It was raining, and {X_definite} kept working the field without slowing down. {A_nameDef} stayed out with it longer than {A_pronoun} meant to.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: a quiet hour with a damaged mech

texts.li: {A_nameDef} spent a quiet hour beside {X_definite}, going over the damage plate by plate and talking to it under {A_possessive} breath.
After the others had gone in, {A_nameDef} stayed out with {X_definite} and looked over every dent and scorch mark on it, and noted how each one came.
{A_nameDef} sat beside {X_definite} and went over its damage slowly, part by part, making a list of what would need fixing first.
[night] Late at night {A_nameDef} was still out by {X_definite}, checking the worst of the damage and saying quietly that it had done well.
The way {X_definite} set its load down beside {A_nameDef}, square to the wall and not a hand's width out, made {A_objective} laugh out loud.
{A_nameDef} thanked {X_definite} for carrying the crate before remembering it couldn't hear, and then thanked it again anyway.
{X_definite} stopped and waited while {A_nameDef} crossed in front of it, then carried on with its load. {A_nameDef} thought that was more polite than most people.
{A_nameDef} watched {X_definite} stack a load neatly against the wall and tried to work out how it always knows where the edge is.
{A_nameDef} took the heavy end of the load from {X_nameDef} without being asked, and the two of them carried it the rest of the way together.
{A_nameDef} told {X_nameDef} the work was good, and meant it. {X_nameDef} didn't answer, but stood a little straighter for the rest of the day.
{A_nameDef} asked {X_nameDef} where {X_pronoun} grew up, and listened to the answer all the way to the end of the row.
{X_nameDef} was singing under {X_possessive} breath at work, a song from home. {A_nameDef} stopped to listen, and {X_nameDef} sang the last verse properly.
{A_nameDef} heard {X_nameDef} humming a tune {A_pronoun} didn't know and asked what it was. A harvest song, {X_nameDef} said, from a long way off.
[evening] In the evening {X_nameDef} sang a slow song from home while working, and {A_nameDef} sat down nearby to listen until it ended.
{A_nameDef} asked {X_nameDef} to sing the song from home again, and {X_pronoun} did, quietly, so only the two of them heard.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: a hard word from the overseer

texts.li: {A_nameDef} caught {X_nameDef} idling by the stores and told {X_objective} so, loudly enough for everyone in earshot to hear.
{X_nameDef} was slow with the work again, and {A_nameDef} stood over {X_objective} until it was done.
{A_nameDef} found {X_nameDef} resting when there was work waiting, and told {X_objective} sharply to get on with it.
{A_nameDef} checked {X_nameDef}'s work, found it not good enough and made {X_objective} do it again.
Working beside {A_nameDef}, {X_nameDef} showed {A_objective} the way {X_possessive} people do it back home. It was quicker, and {A_nameDef} said so.
{A_nameDef} was making heavy work of it until {X_nameDef} quietly showed {A_objective} a better grip.
{X_nameDef} watched {A_nameDef} struggle for a while, then showed {A_objective} a simpler way to do it. {A_nameDef} tried it and it worked.
{A_nameDef} asked {X_nameDef} how {X_possessive} people did this kind of work. {X_nameDef} showed {A_objective}, and {A_nameDef} decided to do it that way from now on.
{A_nameDef} stood at the holding platform watching {X_definite} for most of an hour, filling a page with notes on how it moves.
{A_nameDef} came out of the holding room with a new question about {X_definite} and spent hours trying to answer it.
{A_nameDef} sat outside the holding room for a long while, watching {X_definite} and writing down every time it moved.
{A_nameDef} spent an evening trying to work out what {X_definite} actually is, and came away with more questions than answers.
{A_nameDef} walked past the holding room and felt {X_definite} turn to watch {A_objective} go, and after that {A_pronoun} took the long way round.
Something about the way {X_definite} lay still on the platform kept {A_nameDef} looking over {A_possessive} shoulder for hours afterwards.
{A_nameDef} had to go past {X_definite} today and did it quickly, without looking. {A_pronoun} was jumpy for the rest of the day.
[night] {A_nameDef} lay awake thinking about {X_definite} in its holding room, and didn't sleep well.
{A_nameDef} stood at the door of the holding room and asked whether {X_definite} gets lonely. Nobody had an answer.
{A_nameDef} wanted to know what {X_definite} eats, where it came from and whether it dreams, and kept asking until someone fetched a book.
{A_nameDef} asked whether {X_definite} is ever let out, and whether it wants to be. Nobody gave {A_objective} a straight answer.
{A_nameDef} drew a picture of {X_definite} and asked whether it had a name.
